visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a bright blue puffer jacket, black beanie, and black face mask walks past a city information board on a snow-covered sidewalk. Modern multi-story buildings with colorful accents are visible in the background under an overcast sky. (2) The scene transitions to a ski resort with multiple individuals in winter sportswear. A person in a white and grey tree-patterned camouflage jacket and a black helmet stands on the snowy slope. Other skiers and ski lifts are visible in the distance. (3) A person in a red and white ski jacket stands with their back to the camera, looking at a large red Torii gate covered in snow. The surrounding trees are frosted with ice, and the atmosphere is foggy and white. (4) A rapid sequence shows a person in a white snowsuit snowboarding down a sunlit slope, carving into the snow. The camera uses fast cuts to show close-ups of goggles, snowboards, and a bright sun flare against a clear blue sky.
